---[[
--- PS1: lua注册的事件监听函数自动移除可能会产生问题，所以必须手动移除
--- PS2: 组件的生命周期，无法保证在OnDispose时已触发OnRemoveFromStage，所以在OnDispose时需要注意判断是否正在显示
---]]

local function empty_func() end

---@class Toast: UIGLabel
---@field protected m_in FairyGUI.Transition    进入动画
---@field protected m_out FairyGUI.Transition   退出动画
---@field public delay number  展示时间
local Toast = class("ToastImpl", UIGLabel)
Toast.WAIT_LAST_TOAST_ENTER = true       -- 是否等待上个Toast进入
Toast.WAIT_LAST_TOAST_EXIT  = true       -- 是否等待上个Toast退出

Toast.isCleaning = false
Toast.isAniming   = false
Toast.s_sequence = {}
Toast.s_currentToast = false
Toast.s_coroutine_delay = false

local function ShowOneCoroutine(cor, toast)
    Toast.s_currentToast = toast
    toast:Show()
    Toast.isAniming = Toast.WAIT_LAST_TOAST_ENTER
    Toast.ShowNext()
    coroutine.wait_callback(toast.DoShowAnimation, {toast, empty_func}, {empty_func})
    Toast.isAniming = false

    if toast == Toast.s_currentToast and #Toast.s_sequence <= 0 then
        Toast.s_coroutine_delay = coroutine.start(function(delay)
            coroutine.wait(delay)
        end, toast.delay)
        coroutine.wait_cro(Toast.s_coroutine_delay, cor)
        Toast.s_coroutine_delay = false
    end

    Toast.isAniming = Toast.WAIT_LAST_TOAST_ENTER and Toast.WAIT_LAST_TOAST_EXIT
    Toast.ShowNext()
    coroutine.wait_callback(toast.DoHideAnimation, {toast, empty_func}, {empty_func})
    Toast.isAniming = false
    toast:Hide()

    if toast == Toast.s_currentToast then
        Toast.s_currentToast = false
        return Toast.ShowNext()
    end
end

function Toast.ShowOneToast(toast)
    local cor = coroutine.create(ShowOneCoroutine)
    coroutine.resume(cor, cor, toast)
end

function Toast.ShowNext()
    if Toast.isCleaning then return end
    if Toast.isAniming then return end

    if Toast.s_coroutine_delay then
        coroutine.stop(Toast.s_coroutine_delay)
        Toast.s_coroutine_delay = false
        return Toast.ShowNext()
    end

    local toast = table.remove(Toast.s_sequence, 1)
    if not toast then return end
    if toast.isDisposed then return Toast.ShowNext() end
    return Toast.ShowOneToast(toast)
end

function Toast.ClearAll()
    Toast.isCleaning = true
    if Toast.s_coroutine_delay then
        coroutine.stop(Toast.s_coroutine_delay)
        Toast.s_coroutine_delay = false
    end

    if Toast.s_currentToast then
        Toast.s_currentToast:Hide()
    end
    Toast.s_currentToast = false

    for _, toast in ipairs(Toast.s_sequence) do
        toast:Hide()
    end
    Toast.s_sequence = {}
    Toast.isCleaning = false
end

function Toast:ctor()
    Toast.super.ctor(self)

    self.delay = 3 -- default 3 seconds

    self.isShow = false
    table.insert(Toast.s_sequence, self)

    self.onAdded = function()
        self:OnShow()
    end
    self.onRemove = function()
        self:OnHide()
    end
    self.onAddedToStage:Add(self.onAdded)
    self.onRemovedFromStage:Add(self.onRemove)
end

function Toast:OnShow()
    self.isShow = true
    self.visible = false
    Toast.ShowNext()
end

function Toast:OnHide()
    self.isShow = false
end

function Toast:Show()
    if not self.isDisposed then
        self.visible = true
    end
end

function Toast:Hide()
    if not self.isDisposed then
        self:Dispose()
    end
end

---@param callback fun():void
function Toast:DoShowAnimation(callback)
    if not self.isDisposed and self.m_in then
        return self.m_in:Play(callback)
    else
        return callback and callback()
    end
end

---@param callback fun():void
function Toast:DoHideAnimation(callback)
    if not self.isDisposed and self.m_out then
        return self.m_out:Play(callback)
    else
        return callback and callback()
    end
end

return Toast
